name: Pyromancer: Agonizing Burns lengthens Blaze by 20% (#3322)
contract: #3322: Agonizing Burns 803452 effect 0 is ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108), misc 1 = SPELLMOD_DURATION, base 19 + 1 = +20%, class mask A 0x200 = every Blaze rank (805500 asserted, DBC duration 15000 ms). Aura::CalcMaxDuration applies SPELLMOD_DURATION natively (SpellAuras.cpp:812), no module script touches 803452, so Blaze goes from 15000 ms to 18000 ms. Fireball-family control spell Cinderheart 800806 (outside the mask) must stay unchanged. The periodic-haste half (aura 316 on the same mask) is not measurable with the available metrics and is not asserted. Regression guard for behaviour that already works natively.
